notes.title: DEMO UPDATE BETA v0.50
notes.content:
[p][b]HOLD ATTACKS, DOUBLE BEAT ATTACKS AND NEW UPGRADES! [/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ve added Hold Attacks, a new default mechanic that will make balancing Rhythm and Combat easier. Players are able to “spend” their combo counter by holding the Beat Input to automatically hit the beat. This allows the player to focus on Rhythm as they build up their combo and then focus on the Combat once their combo counter is high enough.  [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve added new upgrade “triggers” to vary up our existing upgrades. This modifies the way upgrades synergize and interact with each other.[/p][list][*][p]Max HP: upgrade will only trigger or be active at Max HP[/p][/*][*][p]Low HP: upgrade will only trigger or be active at Max HP[/p][/*][*][p]Combo: upgrade will only trigger or be active at a certain Combo Count (+10 to +50)[/p][/*][*][p]Solo: upgrade will only trigger or be active during Solo[/p][/*][*][p]Hold: upgrade will only trigger or be active when player is utilizing Hold Attacks [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ve added several new upgrades and upgrade types to fill out [/p][list][*][p]Double Beat Hit Upgrades: a new input type that requires the player to press Beat Hit in quick succession, varying up their rhythm and triggering the upgrade [/p][/*][*][p]Mark Upgrades: certain attacks will now “mark” enemies, meaning they will take extra damage on the next instance of damage (the damage will remove the mark though)[/p][/*][*][p]Mark Effect Upgrades: marked enemies will experience negative effects like poison, stun or emit attacks hurting other enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Revive Upgrades: the player can now be revived (once per round) if the player dies while conditions are met (solo revive and combo revive)[/p][/*][*][p]Curse Disable Upgrades: curses can now be disabled if the upgrades conditions are triggered (solo curse disable and combo curse disable) [/p][/*][*][p]New Heal Upgrades: healing that trigger based on movement (standing heal and moving heal) [/p][/*][*][p]New Damage Type Upgrades: separated Damage Types into Hit, Shockwave, Projectile and Burst. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve expanded Unlocks in tandem with the new upgrade “triggers” since each powerful upgrade was split into multiple varieties. 
[/p][p]We also added Unlock “Pop Ups” in the results screen so players can track their progress easier. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve set upgrades to all show “effect messages” at the right side of the screen for clarity on when they’re active.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also reset demo progress because of all the recent major changes.[/p][p]
[b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Exclamation Point icon on Unlock (in the main menu) will sometimes not go away even if all available unlocks are activated. [/p][/*][*][p]If you solo during boss white flash the screen will stay white during the duration of the solo activation [/p][/*][*][p]Some Upgrades are not correctly triggering “effect messages” at the right side of the screen [/p][/*][*][p]Max HP Stat Up (ATK/DEF/SPEED) will sometimes not trigger initially until player gets hurt and then heals back to Max HP[/p][/*][*][p]Burst from Drum Instrument’s default attack does not mark (if burst mark is active) and does not increase from burst damage upgrades. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We hope to see you on Release Day![/p][p]Nikko Nikko[/p][p]
[/p]

We’ve adjusted the Boss Health, Enemy Damage and Stat Reward Amounts accordingly. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Future Plans:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Next on our docket is expanding our Upgrade Options to prepare for the full release. notes.title: DEMO UPDATE v0.45
notes.content:
[p][b][i]Update Summary:[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]This update focuses on Cutscenes, Revamping Curses and Performance Improvements. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve reworked some of the loading systems to pre-load more assets before starting a run. This will hopefully address some players getting stutter and long load times on run start. If issues persist we will explore some recently added Godot tools for prepacking shader compilation (which is likely the culprit).[/p][p][/p][p]Cutscenes will now play at the end of each run, with each Absurdity Level getting its own unique story content. The Demo will contain Cutscenes from Chapter 10, 11 and 1 (the story is not told in sequential order) with the other chapters will be locked off for the full game. [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve reworked curses to make them more “predictable” with new UI and narrowing down the options pool during a run. [/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Future Plans:[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be expanding curses and upgrades in the Next Update to increase the “risk/reward” design of their interactions. [/p][p][/p][p]Our intention is to make Upgrades stronger but Curses will directly counter/block certain builds. The added “predictability” of Curses will mean the player is making an educated guess when choosing Normal/Hard difficulty options with Curses (with harder difficulty options made more tempting to pick by better rewards). [/p][p]
[/p][p][b][u]Kill The Music Demo Change Log 0.45[/u][/b][/p][p]
[/p][p][b]Major Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Cutscenes to end of each Absurdity Level[/p][/*][*][p]Added Cutscene Menu for rewatching unlocked Cutscenes [/p][/*][*][p]Set Hard Difficulty to always have a Curse [/p][/*][*][p]Set run to pick 2 to 3 Curses at the start of the run and curses during the run will be picked from these options (instead of all curses)[/p][/*][*][p]Added prompt and UI during Round Start to display possible curses [/p][/*][*][p]Added prompt and UI during Character Select to display Absurdity Info: Enemy Stats, Song List and Curse List.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to load times by pre-loading more assets before run start. [/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Minor Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Polished Upgrade Descriptions for Clarity [/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced Absurdity 1 to be easier [/p][/*][*][p]Returned Beat Leeway for “Good” Hits to be easier while maintaining difficulty for “Perfect” Hits[/p][/*][*][p]Set Fragment Upgrade Option to scale amount up according to Absurdity Level[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered Unlock Requirements for Unlockable Upgrades [/p][/*][*][p]Improved tracking and effective range of Bass Vortex Upgrade[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Absurdity Level 3 Easy Difficulty was incorrectly set to more health than Normal or Hard Difficulty.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]When stacking Solo Stat Upgrades (like Solo Atk Up and Solo Def Up they will sometimes not stack and only one or the other will activate, should be both)[/p][/*][*][p]Curses uses the term “Med” and Round Start uses term “Normal” to refer to difficulty (inconsistent) [/p][/*][*][p]Solo Def Up and Solo Attack Up description text don’t specify that that upgrade enables the boost when soloing with that specific instrument (indicated by the portrait when selecting upgrade) (unclear) [/p][/*][*][p]Boss Curses don’t pick from the curse run pool but from all curses (making it too unpredictable)[/p][/*][*][p]Drum "Firing Rate +2/+3" Upgrade in Tutorial will sometimes fail to be gained after selecting. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][i]Hot Fix v0.45b:[/i][/b] Absurdity 2 Round 9 Hard Difficulty had it's Kill Quota set to 5 (instead of 65) and if it spawned as a Kill Quota + Timer Room, the quota value would be automatically lowered by -10 resulting in a -5 Kill Quota Room, freezing the game.  [/p]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE v0.44
notes.content:
This update focuses on Upgrade Unlocks and Progression Balance. 

We've added unlockable upgrades (via recorded game actions like enemies killed) and we’ve reworked Player, Enemy, Boss and Rewards Stats across the 3 Absurdities in the Demo.

We weren't able to include Cutscenes in this Update but Story Content, Upgrade Tuning and Boss Polish will be the focus of our June Update. 

[u][b]Kill The Music Demo Change Log 0.44[/b][/u]

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added New Menu called Unlocks that track certain game actions (ie. Enemies Killed) and will “Unlock” powerful upgrades after conditions are met. 
[*] Increased Overall Round Start Reward Values (ie. Damage +5% to Damage +25%)
[*] Added new Round Start Reward: “New Instrument Guaranteed” to force New Instrument to appear during the next upgrade screen if completed. 
[*] Added system to “force” certain rewards during a run for Hard Option (ie. Damage +25% in A2/A3 Round 4)
[*] Set “New Instrument” Upgrade Option Icon to include a colored fire fx to indicate importance to players. 
[*] Re-tuned Fragment Rewards(meta-upgrade currency), Inspiration Costs (meta-upgrades)  and Player/Enemy Stats to encourage playing current Absurdity instead of grinding previous Absurdity for meta-upgrades. 
[*] Reset current player save progress because of overall progression tuning. 
[/list]

[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimized Solo “Portrait Slide-In” animation to improve loading performance. 
[*] Increased Song Volume during “solo activation” slightly 
[*] Sped up “Negative Energy” song speed and sync slightly 
[*] “No Reward” as a Round Start option will now automatically lower Kill Quota or Timer by 10%
[*] Reduced frequency of Timer Rounds 
[*] Set New Instrument Upgrade Option to be slightly more common but become more uncommon with each additional instrument. 
[*] Re-tuned Round Start “Curse” selection and rotation. 
[*] Allowed small Drum Enemies to be knockbacked when attacked. 
[*] Set Dash Enemies to be uninterruptible during Dash Attack. 
[*] Added red indicator icons when there are new Inspiration, Unlocks, or Absurdities available for the player. 
[*] Added red indicator icons if player has not played the tutorial. 
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Dodge Heal now does not make players invincible after use. 
[/list]

notes.title: MAJOR DEMO UPDATE v0.43
notes.content:
This new major update focuses on changes that respond to the feedback we got from the February 2025 Steam Next Fest. 

We’ve revamped Kill The Music's major gameplay related to dodging, solos and visual clarity. We’ve also added some quality of life features like Beat Sync Adjustment Settings. 

We have another big update coming later this month featuring Unlocks and Cutscenes, stay tuned and thanks for playing! 

[u][b]Kill The Music Demo Changelog v0.43[/b][/u]

[i][b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Dodges are now executed by holding the Dodge Input and releasing the button to “quick stop” (Previously dodges were a single input and quick stop was done through an additional input)
[*] Dodges can now be “curved” by pressing movement input during the dodge. 
[*] Visual Clarity improvements through UI, background color, and enemy color polish.
[*] The Solo mechanics have been reworked to involve quick rhythmic inputs that power the player’s knockback range on completion (combat is paused during, making it feel like a "solo")
[*] Solo will now change the player sprite to that instrument’s assigned character for the duration of the solo. 
[*] We removed “Double Time” and “Double Time on Solo” from the upgrade options pool and instead created a Mode Select at the start of your run.
[*] Added a new setting in the main menu called “Beat Adjust” that allows players to add or subtract “beat delay” to tailor the feel of the beat sync to the players preferences.
[*] Buffed the drum instrument’s ability to attack multiple enemies by adding a small “impact” on hit. 
[*] Removed combo “breaking” or “resetting” on missed beat hits and instead set misses to -1 Combo Counter (no inputs will have no effect, allowing players to drop the rhythm monetarily to re-focus or re-adjust) 
[*] We now allow dodges not "on-beat" for combat flexibility but they will -1 your Combo Counter as a result. 
[/list]

[i][b]MINOR CHANGES [/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Several Bug Fixes to combat and menu navigation. 
[*] Overall Balance Polish to enemy and boss stats. 
[*] Tutorial Polish regarding pacing, wording and presentation 
[*] Beat Circle Polish regarding animation speed and easing
[*] Improved Overall Beat Sync 
[*] Settings are now saved and applied on start up (audio/window/beat sync)
[*] Revamped song pool with a smaller selection of songs (including new songs) as we polish up and revamp our previous tracks. 
[*] Added a new “slow follow” enemy for earlier rounds to ease players into the balancing rhythm and combat. 
[*] Added automatic transparency to beat circle as combo count gets higher to slowly transition player to pay more attention to combat (this gets reset on misses or solo) 
[*] Revamped Hints in pause menu
[/list]

[b][u]KNOWN BUGS[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Dodge Heal Upgrade will sometimes cause the player to be unable to take damage 
[/list]

notes.title: NEXT FEST DEMO UPDATE: v0.42
notes.content:
We’re celebrating Kill The Music achieving 15 000 Wishlists with a New Update that factors in some recent feedback from the Steam Next Fest players. 

We appreciate everyone’s support and hope you enjoy these changes!

[u][b]Kill The Music Demo Changelog v0.42[/b][/u]

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies now display a warning to indicate movement direction and distance before lunging to the beat of the music. 
[*] Enemies do not move/lunge immediately after spawning.
[*] Enemies have their hitbox disabled for the first beat after spawning (but enemies retain their hurtbox so they can be attacked)
[/list]

[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Gold skulls now do not turn red on hit and retain their gold color for clarity. 
[*] Slowed down default projectiles slightly 
[*] Removed controls reminders for early songs for Absurdity 2 and 3
[*] Drum Starting Instrument is buffed to have +50% Meter Gain along with her Solo Attack Boost.
[*] Set Rotating Laser enemy to not lunge to beat and just move slowly and steadily.  
[*] When using Quick Retry to keep 1 Upgrade, if the Upgrade involves an added Instrument (not your starting instrument) both the Upgrade and the added Instrument will be kept. 
[*] Attached Beat Hit SFX to Beat Volume Slider.
[*] Anger Level 2 and Level 3 attack stat bonus increased.
[*] Fear Level 2 and Level 3 attack stat bonus increased.
[*] Boss Health increased slightly. 
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Keyboard correctly displayed +50% Beat Dmg on stats page (instead of 200%)
[*] Fixed issue where Bass Upgrade: Vortex only spawned vortexes when solo was activated (should have been every beat hit)
[*] Fixed issue where Enemies can get stuck when spawning on stage. 
[*] Fixed issue where player can sometimes fail to gain meter when Combo Shield was up. 
[/list]

notes.title: NEXT FEST DEMO: v0.41
notes.content:
This update focuses on gameplay polish, balance tuning and bug fixes for our February 2025 Next Fest Demo. 

We'll have an additional hotfix update later in the week for our known issues, additional polish and adjustments based on player feedback from next fest.

Stay tuned!


[u][b]Kill The Music Demo Change Log 0.41[/b][/u]


[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] REBALANCE: Retuned enemy spawns, Adjusted beat sync, Decreased the “Perfect” beat window and Decreased some Inspiration Costs. 
[*] STATS PAGE: Added a stats page to Round Start so players can keep track of their current active Round Start reward stats.
[*] ABSURDITY: Added a simple explanation to Absurdity Levels on mouse hover or setting change. 
[*] SOLO DOUBLE TIME: Set Solo Double Time to be guaranteed on Song 1 Upgrade Options with its rarity going up significantly with every subsequent Song that run. 
[*] INSPIRATION REFUNDS: Added prompt in Inspiration Menu to refund meta-upgrades for better control of player difficulty. 
[/list]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed combo shield from grey to white for better clarity. 
[*] Set Absurdity “LVL” text to black to draw more attention to it. 
[*] Increased dodge invul window slightly. 
[*] Set Boss hurt SFX to be slightly quieter 
[*] Set shockwave enemy “warning” circle to be grey instead of red for consistency with laser enemy. 
[*] Slightly decreased meter gain during Solo. 
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where fragment value in Main Menu would not correctly update after buying/refunding fragments in Inspiration Menu.
[*] Fixed issue where “Miss” can still be triggered and end combos with off-beat Solo triggers.
[*] Fixed issue with off-center control prompt icons.
[*] Fixed issue where tutorial round start difficulty “Easy” would display an estimated enemy count of “10+” but the actual value was “30+”.
[*] Fixed issue where solo prompt can be covered by the Beat Hit FX during the tutorial freeze.
[*] Fixed issue where for longer rounds, BGM Song will sometimes not loop.
[*] Fixed issue where players can get a freeze if they click outside of the continue bar after a successful run end. 
[*] Fixed issue where triggering “Deal” on a new instrument will have no function. 
[*] Fixed issue where the Pause Hint Menu was not navigable through mouse clicks. 
[*] Fixed issue where Quick Retry would sometimes keep starting instrument as the kept upgrade when other upgrades were available. 
[*] Fixed issue where player could access Settings Menu while in the Inspiration UI with quick clicks during menu start up. 
[/list]
[b]Known Issues [/b]
[list]
[*] Keyboard char condition says +50% to Beat DMG but stats page will display +200% Beat DMG.
[*] Triggering Round Start Help can make stats prompt be invisible until stats is pressed prompt is pressed (only occurs on gamepad).
[*] Enemies can spawn on stage and get stuck. 
[*] Vortex Bass Upgrade is functioning incorrectly add only generating vortexes on Solo (should be on every active beat hit).
[*] Some slight beat desync for rounds longer than 2+ Mins or 3 Song Loops.
[*] Getting a -1 Sec bonus on kill as timer reaches 0 can cause it to reset.
[*] Quick Retry shows correct ghost portrait but defaults to Roxie Guitar for end part instead of actual starting instrument.
[*] Guitar beam can trigger even when guitar is not the active instrument 
[/list]

notes.title: NEXT FEST DEMO PREVIEW: v0.40
notes.content:
This update is an early preview for our February 2025 Steam Next Fest Demo. We’ve added boss fights, progression, meta-upgrades, new movement options and much more!

In the next week or so we’ll be doing some additional polish, balancing and bug fixing for the full Steam Next Fest Demo. 

Stay tuned! 

[u][b]Kill The Music Demo Change Log v0.40[/b][/u]

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] BOSS FIGHTS: Added Boss Fights to the end of every run (round count changes based on absurdity) 
[*] MOVEMENT: Added Mechanic where the player can cancel their dodge animation/movement by re-inputting dodge input during the dodge. 
[*] META-UPGRADES: Added meta-upgrades called “Inspiration” that boost starting stats
[*] META-UPGRADES: Added Fragments as a meta-upgrade currency, obtainable through round start bonus, upgrade choices or boss fights. 
[*] ABSURDITY: Added Absurdity Levels that modify the game’s difficulty and length (new Absurdity Levels are unlocked with each completed run with a current maximum of Absurdity Level 3)
[*] QUICK RETRY: Added quick retry options in the game over screen that allows the player to keep one random upgrade from their last run 
[*] SAVE SYSTEM: Added Save System (records inspiration unlocks, fragment count and max absurdity). Note: Save System currently does not save settings values, so they will be reset when build is closed/relaunched.

notes.content:
This update focuses on wrapping up Mouse Controls, simplified the one button Solo Triggers, polish to the Combo Mechanics and New Content.

[list]
[*] [b]MOUSE CONTROLS:[/b] Fully implemented mouse controls (menus now fully navigable by mouse)
[*] [b]SOLO:[/b] Solo Input is now simplified (Keyboard: Space and Gamepad: A) to help players stay in a state of flow.
[*] [b]COMBO:[/b] Default starting combo effect is now a damage bonus instead of a speed bonus.
[*] [b]NEW CONTENT:[/b] New Laser and Shockwave Enemies and New Combo/Dodge Upgrades
[*] [b]BEAT SYNC:[/b] Adjusted overall beat-sync to align with the larger beat circle initially “touching” the small circle (was previously set to small circle glow and/or full overlap) 
[/list]


[u][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Round Start Options now have ??? events that hide information from the player. 
[*] New Dodge Upgrades that “consume” your current combo count to activate an effect that scales the consumed value (heal/damage)
[*] New Shield Upgrade that’s triggered when you hit a certain combo count (combo count is reset when shield is “popped”)
[*] New Laser and Shockwave Enemies for later rounds. 
[*] Since Solo Animation has simplified/sped up, the full character animations now play at round end instead. Order is randomized. 
[*] Added Song Counter near player health bar 
[*] Enemies are set to die to the beat of the music (timed to double time pacing so wait time isn’t too long)
[*] Enemies set to grey tint when “waiting to die” for clarification that they’re not active anymore
[*] Powered up enemies (via curse or mini boss) now have an inverted color for clarity 
[*] Deal and Rerolls are now fully randomized instead of Deals being guaranteed after a certain point in the run.
[*] Deals and Rerolls costs now start at -1 HP and -1 MAX HP to promote early use 
[*] Deals and Reroll costs double with each use (resets after run)

[/list]

[*] Combo Shield: Shield that protects for 1 Hit is spawned at 30 Combo but combo is reset when shield is popped 
[*] Dodge Attack Up: x2 Damage for 5 Seconds if the player successfully dodges an attack (damage bonus stacks)
[*] Dodge Shockwave: on Dodge, create a shockwave that will do Damage x4 their current combo count. Combo count is then reset back to 0. 
[*] Dodge Heal: on Dodge, heal x0.25 your current combo count. Combo count is then reset back to 0. 
[*] Dodge Instrument: your instruments are no longer “disabled” during dodge and will continue to do damage.
[*] X3 Combo On Solo: combo count will tick up by 3 for each successful beat hit when in Solo (a progressive upgrade from x2 Combo on Solo Upgrade)
[/list]

[list]
[*] Starting Player Defence is slightly increased
[*] Starting Player Pick Up Range is slightly increased

[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Kill Combo upgrade would sometimes continually tick up combo count 
[*] Fixed issue where instrument transparency would inconsistently apply when dodging (indicates that instruments are disabled during dodge)

notes.title: KILL THE MUSIC DEMO UPDATE: v0.36: Rhythm, Combos, Dodge and Instrument Stacking
notes.content:
This update focuses on changes responding to the most frequent recurring player feedback: 
[list]
[*] [b]RHYTHM:[/b] We added Rhythm Upgrades (Double Time Solo and Double Time) to increase the Beat frequency, increasing the difficulty of the Rhythm Gameplay but also boosting player DPS greatly! 
[*] [b]COMBO:[/b] We’ve added a Combo system that ticks up with each successful Beat Hit. By Default it increases movement speed but we’ve added upgrades that add Damage, Defence or Healing depending on your combo count. To synergize with this new system we’ve added upgrades that increase Combo count during Solo and an upgrade that increases Combos per kill. 
[*] [b]DODGE ROLL:[/b] We’ve added a Player Dodge to add variety to player movement. Dodges have to be done on beat and will count as a “Tick Up” for your Combo Counter.
[*] [b]INSTRUMENT STACKING:[/b] Players were frustrated that additional instruments can feel like a downgrade because of the “switching mechanic”. By default all instruments are now present and out at all times. We’ve incorporated the previous system by denoting an “active” instrument per beat that is “powered up” by your beat hit but all instruments will be out and attacking on every beat. 
[*] [b]KEYBOARD MOUSE CONTROLS:[/b] We received some negative feedback for our default Keyboard Controls so we’ve added mouse controls for Beat Hit and Dodge. We did not manage to make menus “clickable” in time but our next update should fix that. 
[*] [b]SOLO ANIMATION:[/b] Some players love our Solo Cut-IN animations and others have felt it interrupted gameplay too much. We’ve set all Solos to now use a “quick” version of the animation, reducing the amount of screen coverage, making the beat circle visible during the entire activation. This should help players keep their combo going. 
[/list]
For additional clarity for gameplay changes we’ve updated the Playable Tutorial in build.

Our next update will focus on wrapping up menu mouse controls, gameplay pacing polish, gameplay variety polish and additional upgrades. 

[u][b]Additional Change Log for Kill The Music Early Alpha v0.36[/b][/u]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Guitar is now mirrored (one guitar on each side) by default 
[*] Added a “Lunge” to guitar attacks to increase its reach and attack distance. 
[*] Since Guitars are now mirrored by default, Solos will instead add smaller guitars to attack closer to the player to cover its hitbox blindspots. 
[*] Beat UI is polished to feel more in-sync.
[*] Added new upgrade “category” for rhythm and combo related upgrades (Rhythm)
[*] Added New Round Start Curse: Player Hurt Resets Combo 
[*] Added a Mechanic for “Timer” rooms where some kills will reduce the timer by 1 Sec.
[*] Improved Drum auto-targeting so it misses less
[*] When the player reaches Combo 10 and speeds up an “afterimage” fx is applied.
[*] When the player dodges their instruments are set to a “transparent mode” and player attacks for that beat are nullified.
[*] Slow down overall projectile speed so they’re easier to dodge roll through.
[*] Since overall projectile speed is slower now we’ve added a New Enemy that specifically fires fast projectiles. They only spawn in the later rounds though. 
[*] Added at least 1 projectile enemy in the earlier rooms (Rounds 1 to 3)
[*] Added Combo protection on one no input (missed input attempts will count though)
[*] Added Combo protection during solo activation/animation 
[*] Solo Trigger/Activation on Beat ticks up combo counter but has solo protection if off-beat 
[*] Keyboard Instrument only “fast moves” on beat hit now 
[*] Drum has smaller weaker projectile when off-beat

[/list]

[b]New Upgrades:[/b]
[list]
[*] Double Time Solo: Increase Beat and Attack Frequency when in Solo
[*] Double Time: Increase Beat and Attack Frequency at all times.
[*] Combo Defence Up: Increase Player Defence in tandem with Combo Counter
[*] Combo Attack Up: Increase Player Attackin tandem with Combo Counter
[*] X2 Combo On Solo: During Solo each combo tick up will be doubled (+2 instead of +1)
[*] Combo Heal: Heal 1HP per beat when Combo Counter is above 20.
[*] Kill Combo: Kills will now count as Combo Counter tick ups.
[/list]

[b]Bugs [/b]
[list]

[*] Fixed big message bug for solo defense up.
[*] Fixed round start time formatting issue would say 2:8 instead of 2:08
[/list]

We’ll be working on a hotfix patch for these issues in the coming days.
